extraction.text:
Sunil Jadhav

Continuous Improvement | Business Transformation | Operational Process Excellence

Mobile: +91 9004027200

Email: sunilden@gmail.com

CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT & TRANSFORMATION LEADER

Certified Six Sigma Black Belt with 16+ years of experience leading Continuous Improvement,

Operational Excellence, Business Transformation, and Process Governance across Telecom, Shipping, and ITES domains. Proven track record of delivering measurable business value through Lean Six Sigma, process reengineering, automation, KPI/SLA governance, and data- driven transformation. Experienced in LSS capability building, Green Belt training, Black Belt project mentoring, stakeholder facilitation, knowledge sessions, and change enablement, with a strong focus on profitability and sustainable operational performance.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence • Lean Six Sigma (Black Belt) • Business Transformation & Process Transformation • Process Mapping, Process Mining & Reengineering • Transformation Governance & Performance Management • CI Project Portfolio & Benefits Realization • Automation & Digital Enablement (RPA & AI) • KPI / SLA Design & Governance • Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Leadership up to ground level • Floor event management • Change Management & Adoption • Cost Optimization & FTE Productivity • Theory of Constraints & Lean methodology • Performance Baselining & Root Cause Analysis – 5 why analysis • Risk, Compliance & Process Maturity • Project Governance & Senior Leadership Reviews • Dashboard Development & Data-Driven Analytics

SELECTED TRANSFORMATION & CI ACHIEVEMENTS

Delivered ₹5 Crore+ business value through 40+ Lean Six Sigma / Continuous

Improvement projects.

Delivered 22+ FTE savings through RPA-led dispute automation initiatives. • Reduced disputes inventory by 10% through process optimization and continuous improvement.

Established and governed KPI/SLA frameworks across AP, R2R & HRO processes,

supporting contractual compliance and performance management.

Delivered Lean Six Sigma Green Belt training to 90+ employees across Bharti

Airtel (40+) and Wipro (50+), strengthening enterprise continuous improvement capability.

Mentored and supported 6 Black Belt practitioners/projects across Wipro (3)

and Bharti Airtel (3), providing structured guidance on Lean Six Sigma methodology and project execution.

Delivered Lean Six Sigma programmes, presentations and knowledge sessions at

Wipro, engaging stakeholders and promoting structured continuous improvement practices.

WORK EXPERIENCE

Manager – Quality & Process Excellence

Wipro Limited | Pune May

2018 – April 2025

Designed and governed KPI/SLA frameworks across AP, R2R, and HRO processes to

strengthen performance management and contractual compliance.

Led FTE optimization initiatives supporting cost control, productivity improvement, and

budget adherence.

Conducted CMMI audits and drove process compliance, maturity, and closure of

identified gaps.

Delivered RPA opportunity assessments for global clients, identifying automation

opportunities for process transformation.

Facilitated AI-driven process mapping initiatives to identify improvement opportunities

and enhance profitability and operational efficiency.

Mentored Green Belt projects, enabling structured continuous improvement and

measurable performance gains.

Trained employees on Lean and Six Sigma methodologies to build continuous

improvement capability.

Delivered Lean Six Sigma Green Belt training to 50+ employees at Wipro,

supporting structured capability building across teams.

Mentored and supported 3 Black Belt practitioners/projects at Wipro, providing

guidance on Lean Six Sigma methodology and project execution.

Delivered Lean Six Sigma programmes, presentations and knowledge sessions for Wipro stakeholders, promoting adoption of continuous improvement practices.

Manager – Process Excellence

Maersk Line GSC | Mumbai September

2014 – May 2018

Served as Business SPOC and Scrum Master for RPA transformation initiatives in

dispute processes, including billing and D&D.

Delivered 22+ FTE benefits and reduced disputes inventory by 10% through process

and automation improvements.

Led governance for the GSC Operating System project, tracking key metrics and

performance across global centers.

Supported senior leadership with dashboards, performance analysis, and outlier

identification for improvement actions.

Mentored Green Belt projects and enabled continuous improvement initiatives across

processes.

Manager – Operational Excellence

Bharti Airtel Limited October

2008 – August 2014

Managed 40+ Lean Six Sigma projects delivering business value exceeding ₹5 Crore. • Led project governance and performance reviews with senior management, driving visibility of improvement initiatives and actions.

Delivered Lean Six Sigma Green Belt training to 40+ employees at Bharti Airtel, strengthening organizational capability in structured problem-solving and continuous improvement.

Mentored and supported 3 Black Belt practitioners/projects at Bharti Airtel, providing guidance on Lean Six Sigma methodology and project execution.

Trained and mentored Green Belt projects across functions, strengthening CI capability. • Developed the 'One Council' platform as a GTM intervention supporting the operations committee.

Led audit facilitation and ensured timely closure of identified process gaps.

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Production Engineering – Shivaji University, Kolhapur

CERTIFICATIONS

ASQ Certified Six Sigma Black Belt • SSMI Certified Six Sigma Black Belt • Professional Scrum Master – Scrum.org • PRINCE2 Trained

TECHNICAL & ANALYTICS SKILLS

Minitab • MS Visio • BPMN • MS Project • Power BI • Microsoft Office 365
